notes.title: Language Update: [Japanese], [Simplified Chinese]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146950/3c2becd1a773834553bd53399ddc68aba612e732.png[/img]

Uh... um... nice to meet you, I’m Natalie.

You’re asking what’s been updated this time? Can’t you... just open the game and check for yourself?
What!?
You want me to tell you directly? You’re really something... fine, I’ll only say it once! (Ugh... talking to you face-to-face makes me so nervous.)

[h1]New Languages: Japanese, Simplified Chinese[/h1]
Vivian said we’re in an international society now, so adding more languages will help more people get to know us.
If you find anything strange with the Japanese or Simplified Chinese, feel free to report it to the community. I believe both Vivian and Aisha would be happy to make corrections.
What about me? Why would I... ugh, fine, I’ll fix things too, okay!?

[h3]Voice Lines of Natalie and Vivian Adjusted to Be More Feminine[/h3]
I’ve been working hard on learning new languages too... (quietly)

[h3]Q&A[/h3]
As for the feedback on the Recall Mode... since the story levels and match-3 levels are separate, you can directly revisit the story levels by clicking on them.
Huh? You’re saying the levels are too long, and dragging to select them is inconvenient?
Alright, alright~ I’ll think of a solution, okay!?

notes.title: [Minor Update and Sale]
notes.content:
Huh! Natalie, Vivian, is it me doing the talking again?

Ah... ah! Hello, everyone, it’s me, your old friend Aisha.

I’ve got some updates for you, starting with this: 
[h2]Halloween Sale Event![/h2]
 This is the first holiday discount since our initial launch promotion! (Sigh~ Since the team is still getting the hang of things, it might take a little time for the discount to show up. Make sure to buy once you see the discount applied!) And what's more—our neighbor Miho from Love Quiz Battle is also joining us with a Halloween bundle. If you don’t have both games yet, now’s the perfect time to get them together! It's an amazing deal!

[h2]Balance and Voice Adjustments![/h2]
 Some friends have mentioned to me that the game’s levels seem a bit challenging? Getting everyone stuck wasn’t the plan—I’m excited to see everyone progress! So here we go:
 [h3]‧ Increased moves for all levels by 30%[/h3]

Additionally, a few players noticed that my Japanese wording sounded a bit... masculine!? My apologies for that; I’m now fully committed to refining my Japanese. 
[h3]‧ Aisha’s voice lines have been adjusted to sound more feminine[/h3]

I’ll be sure to share this with Natalie and Vivian as well. Thank you all for your continued support of Three Piggies!
